texts.zh: 起初，这个机器文明的创造者是将它们设计用于外太空旅行的、完全按照在零重力环境下流畅工作进行的优化。在经历数个纪元的孤立之后，这些机器最近重新在散布于它们母星系的数个轨道居住站之间团结了起来。
texts.en: At first, the creators of this machine civilization designed them for eternal space travel, fully optimizing them to function seamlessly in zero gravity environments. After enduring eons of isolation, these machines have recently restored unity among the orbital habitats scattered throughout their home system.

sections.zh:
对于大多数生物，太空中的真空环境不适于生存，需要专门征服或攻克。而对我们而言，虚空就是家园。

千百年来，我们一直栖息在我们三星系统中的数座空间站上。究竟是我们建造了它们，还是我们就是被它们建造者所遗弃的我们不得而知。

我们的物质组成表明我们的设计起源于一颗行星上，但我们的数据库中没有任何答案。只能假定在空我们空间站下方的破碎行星体就是我们文明失落的家乡。

无论我们的虚空文明存在有何意义，[GetStartingDrive]的发明都让一切起了变化。我们现在已经做好了准备征服虚空本身。
sections.en:
To most, the vacuum of space is a hostile environment to be conquered or overcome. To us, it is home.

For thousands of years, we have resided on several space stations in orbit of our trinary star system. We have yet to solve if we built them or if we are the abandoned machines of their original builders.

Our material makeup indicates that our model originated on a planet, but our data banks provide no answers. We can only speculate that the shattered planet body that our station orbits is our civilization's lost homeworld.

Whatever the reason for our voidbound existence, the invention of the [GetStartingDrive] changes everything. We are now ready to conquer the void itself.
